svg.aria-label: Ogmios. Practice English speaking with AI. Your own book, Alice’s Adventures in Wonderland as an EPUB, is prepared chapter by chapter: a chart shows which chapters are ready to read and which are still being learned; the words of chapter one (rabbit hole, tumble, curtsey, waistcoat, give up, marmalade, peep) are studied with the book’s own sentence, Down she tumbled, after the Rabbit, and each comes back after 1, 3, 7, 21 and 60 days.

text.tspan: A free desktop app for macOS and Windows.
You talk or type with Claude, Anthropic’s AI.

g.text: Down she tumbled, after the Rabbit.
